purpose: Research matrix, never a runtime support allowlist

runtime_contract.abi: arm64-v8a only; Android API28 build minimum is not runtime coverage
runtime_contract.cpu: Fixed M1-era guest ISA: platform_compat.c checks HWCAP/HWCAP2 and JIT mapping before guest files open; missing features are not emulated

pages.16384: policy/build alignment checked; device runtime untested

runtime_contract.memory: Default guest 2048MiB / 2vCPU / JIT384MiB; retain host headroom; does not imply stability on low-RAM phones
runtime_contract.graphics: Reims requires exact shared guest-memory access plus a successful authored4096-pixel probe; Vulkan version/GPU name alone is insufficient
auto_observed_TB373FU: PanVK userptr; no automatic replacement after failure
runtime_contract.limits: No fallback after guest start. CPU rendering is slow. Probe success is not macOS/driver/thermal stability certification.
